summary: Round 2 was a verification round: round 1 returned not_converged with 10 blocking findings, all claimed fixed inline at 3891089b by the plan author, with no independent corroboration. Round 2's verdict is that 4 of the 10 (B1 exclusions fail-closed, B2 cross-capability exclusions, B4 opt-in widens the touched set, B9 testpaths) are genuinely closed on every surface. Six new blocking findings replace the rest, and they share one shape: the fixes landed on design.md and tasks.md but not on specs/gen-eval-framework/spec.md, which is the only artifact that survives archive. findings_trend 10 -> 6.

blocking_findings.title: B5 is not closed in the spec delta
blocking_findings.evidence: specs/gen-eval-framework/spec.md:500 'on every push' and :512 'The sweep runs on push, not on a schedule' — the exact rationale D12 now calls refuted. pull_request appears only in design.md:397,400,406 / tasks.md:555 / work-packages.yaml:396.

blocking_findings.title: The misplaced-instance rule fails the gate unconditionally on the current tree
blocking_findings.evidence: openspec/contracts/code-search/v2.yaml begins 'openapi: 3.1.0' and sits at a capability root. spec.md:535-537 makes that a gate failure with no opt-in gating; task 5.7c requires --scope capability to exit zero on the merge candidate. Both cannot hold.

blocking_findings.title: The full sweep's effective requirement set is undefined
blocking_findings.evidence: All resolution is written against 'the active change's spec delta' (spec.md:360-377); D12 (design.md:432) makes --change <id> mandatory precisely because 34 change dirs exist. Capability scope has no active change and no artifact states what it resolves against.

blocking_findings.title: 'instance-format' is undefined and collides with D13's exclusions file
blocking_findings.evidence: The only capability-root files today are code-search/README.md (must not fail) and code-search/v2.yaml (must fail). D13 puts traceability-exclusions.yaml at the same root. Any discovery rule of 'YAML at root' turns D13's opt-in switch into a permanent gate failure.

blocking_findings.title: work-packages claims a preflight the machinery runs last
blocking_findings.evidence: work-packages.yaml:412-420 asserts the precondition is 'ENFORCED, not merely stated' via verification.steps. skills/implement-feature/SKILL.md:332 injects those steps under 'After implementation, run:' and :383 orders Phase B as code-gen -> scope check -> verification.

blocking_findings.title: Task 5.7c is simultaneously human and engineering
blocking_findings.evidence: tasks.md:483 'Tasks 5.4-5.9 are engineering (wp-matrix and wp-wiring)'; tasks.md:589 tags 5.7c [human] (and in trailing position, unlike every other human task); work-packages.yaml:493 enumerates carve-outs as 4.1, 4.2, 4.2b, 5.1, 5.2, 5.3 — 5.7c absent. D1 forbids dispatching [human] tasks; a scheduler resolves this ambiguity by dispatching.
